donorReadme: - Source: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Space Science Institute/Lunar and Planetary Institute Color Maps of Tethys - 2014 (PIA18439)
- Purpose: replace the previous non-2:1 Tethys texture with a web-ready simple-cylindrical Cassini global color map
- Processing: resized locally from the `13467x6734` high-resolution JPEG to a true `4096x2048` JPEG
- Credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Space Science Institute/Lunar and Planetary Institute

coordinates.placement: latLonToXYZ in the donor src/entities/hotspot.ts, on Three.js SphereGeometry UVs
coordinates.longitudeDegrees: exactly as stored in features.json, placed by latLonToXYZ whatever the range; the donor stores values already in its own marker frame (see longitudeRange, markerLongitudeFromSource and donorReadmeNote)
coordinates.position: [radius * sin(phi) * sin(theta), radius * cos(phi), radius * sin(phi) * cos(theta)]
coordinates.donorReadmeNote: - The current Tethys release uses the NASA/JPL PIA18439 Cassini global color map resized to `4K`. Source coordinate labels in `data/tethys-features.json` retain IAU positive-west values; because this texture is registered 180 degrees from the Mimas frame, numeric marker longitudes use `markerLongitude = 180 - westLongitude`, normalized to `[-180, 180]`.
